This page groups words having one of the dual-mater patterns alef-vav or alef-yod. Most groups collect cases where alef-vav corresponds to a ḥolam vowel, while other groups collect cases where alef-vav corresponds to a shuruq vowel or alef-yod corresponds to a ḥiriq vowel.

The short labels are bucket names within this FOI search, not separate grammatical categories. In particular, a-misc is the residual bucket after the more specific named patterns are excluded.

Besides MAM's running text, including the targets of documentation notes, this search reads scroll-difference notes, so a spelling quoted in one is included, with scrdfftar-note in the last column of its row. The bodies of documentation notes are not searched.
